Traditional, manual approaches to cybersecurity assurance simply can’t keep up. That’s where Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) steps in by empowering InfoSec, compliance, and risk leaders to operate with near real-time visibility, automation, and confidence . Gartner summarizes the value of CCM perfectly: “ CCM tools help cybersecurity and IT teams reduce the manual efforts for cybersecurity control assurance and monitoring activities, partially relieving staff burden and enabling them to focus on higher-value tasks, and reduce costs. The tools also enable constant monitoring of cybersecurity controls, allowing faster detection of potential threats and minimizing breaches and regulatory noncompliance, which prevents significant financial and reputational damage. They not only enhance a company’s cybersecurity posture but also build a more secure, successful business.” Cypago’s Role in the Shift Toward Continuous Assurance At Cypago, we believe Cyber GRC should be as dynamic and continuous as the environments it protects . Our platform automates the assessment and monitoring of cybersecurity and compliance controls across the hybrid enterprise, enabling teams to scale oversight, reduce risk, and demonstrate continuous compliance. jobs.description: Call us Toll Free (USA): 1-833-844-9468 International: +1-603-280-4451 M-F 8am to 6pm EST Cyber Defense Magazine Cyber Defense Awards Cyber Defense Webinars Cyber Defense Conferences Cyber Defense TV Cyber Defense Radio Subscribe Home Press Releases Contact Submit a Press Release Cypago Announces Strategic Partnership with Archer® to Deliver AI-Driven Continuous Controls Monitoring for Enterprises [Tel-Aviv, Israel – 19 th November 2025 ] – Cypago , Agentic AI Cyber GRC (Governance Risk and Compliance) has announced a strategic partnership with Archer , a global leader in enterprise compliance and risk management solutions, to deliver AI-driven continuous controls monitoring (CCM) for businesses. Cypago’s agentic AI automation continuously monitors, analyzes, and mitigates security controls in real time, underpinning cyber compliance and governance. This allows enterprises to achieve continuous controls assurance and completely eradicate reliance on outdated, inefficient, long-winded manual processes currently still associated with security compliance and controls. In today’s rapidly evolving regulatory and cyber risk landscape, most enterprises still rely on manual methods for many cybersecurity compliance activities, lacking ongoing visibility which increases cyber and liability risks, constraining resources and limiting opportunities for growth. Likewise, the burden on companies to demonstrate security audit readiness is growing – with audits costing tens of thousands of dollars and taking months to complete on average. Relying on spreadsheets and manual processes for evidence collection and security control testing further increases cyber risks, inhibits resilience and efficiency, and can lead to errors. Cypago offers continuous oversight and real time security controls assurance, so data is accounted for and security policies and controls are adhered to. Cypago’s Agentic Cyber GRC platform equips GRC teams with a bird’s eye view over security controls, and security teams with ongoing visibility and automatic updates, ensuring companies are always “audit ready.” “Our partnership with Cypago enables us to provide Archer clients with continuous automated oversight of, and insight to, their IT and security controls. This is a step change for how enterprises engage with security controls assurance,” said Jeff Longoria, Chief Commercial Officer at Archer.” “This strategic partnership between Archer and Cypago provides automated, Agentic-AI driven, 360 degree monitoring, so no security controls, policies or risks are overlooked,” said Yahav Peri, Co-Founder and CEO of Cypago. “Through real-time control monitoring, we are enabling enterprises to identify security controls gaps and findings immediately, respond at pace and ensure their overall security and compliance posture is watertight. Security compliance isn’t just an operational cost; Continuous Controls Monitoring is a force multiplier for reducing business risks, building trust and driving sustained growth.” The partnership comes at a time of momentum for Cypago as the company ushers in its next phase of rapid growth. The company is poised to drive innovation and expansion through its proprietary LLM, Agentic AI, and automation technologies, supporting enterprises and Fortune 500 companies worldwide. About Cypago Cypago is an Israeli-US based company delivering an Agentic-AI Cyber GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) SaaS platform that transforms the way enterprises manage Cybersecurity GRC. The platform is designed to help organizations reduce cyber risk, align with security frameworks, monitor security controls, streamline security compliance audits, and eliminate manual effort through next-generation agentic AI automation.
